title: Little Boys Corky & Roger with Shovels on Dirt Mound, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A square black-and-white snapshot capturing two young blonde boys, identified on the back as Corky and Roger, playfully posing on top of a large mound of dirt or gravel. The older boy holds a full-sized spade shovel upright while the toddler stands beside him in overalls holding a smaller shovel or stick. In the background sits a suburban or rural yard with full deciduous trees and a house, reflecting wholesome outdoor play in mid-1950s America.
